summary: Performed a read-only sweep of global agent histories (.pi, .claude, .codex, .gizmo) and TypeSafe readiness. Confirmed the typesafe-ai skill is installed at the project level only, mapped where model-choice and session history lives per agent, and verified that no TYPESAFE_* env vars and no local typesafe SDK are present.
decisions: TypeSafe-AI skill is installed only at C:/Users/mchan/projects/gizmo/.agents/skills/typesafe-ai/SKILL.md (project scope), not in ~/.gizmo/skills/ or ~/.pi/agent/ — agents reading from global skill dirs will not see it.
Jev API calls are not possible from this environment until TYPESAFE_API_KEY (and optionally TYPESAFE_BASE_URL) are set and the typesafe JS SDK is installed via npm.
docs.typesafe.ai accessibility was deliberately not tested (no network calls per the user constraint); SDK integration details must be fetched live at build time.
errors: First bash tool call (combined env + npm + node_modules check) timed out after 3 minutes; subsequent calls were split into smaller 15s timeouts and succeeded.
Duplicate read of package.json for 'typesafe' returned no matches, confirming typesafe is not declared as a dependency in gizmo/package.json.
